notes: Home fills in about twice as fast. Every shelf was fetching a second page it had no use for: one request already returns fifty titles, and a row that shows about ten was being held to sixty before it would settle. That floor exists so the Discover grid is always tall enough to scroll, and a single sideways row has nothing to scroll, so it no longer applies to one. Home also shows the shape of what is coming rather than an empty page: the hero and any shelf that has not answered yet are drawn as placeholder cards at the exact size of the real ones, with a pale band crossing them, so nothing moves when the real covers land. Reduce motion leaves the placeholders still.
